facts.text: The hotel is at 701 Stone Canyon Road in Bel Air, Los Angeles, a mile west of Beverly Hills and half a mile from Sunset Boulevard.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel in Bel Air, Los Angeles, is located at 701 Stone Canyon Road, CA 90077. It's a mile west of Beverly Hills and half a mile from Sunset Boulevard.

facts.text: Both the airport and the beach are around 30 to 40 minutes away.
facts.excerpt: Both the airport and the beach are around 30-40 minutes away.

facts.text: The estate is set within 12 acres of landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: Cradled in the embrace of 12 acres of fragrant, landscaped gardens

facts.text: 483 specimen trees and more than 4,000 plants surround the paths through the hotel grounds.
facts.excerpt: 483 specimen trees and more than 4,000 plants surround paths that weave through the hotel grounds like an intriguing secret.

facts.text: Most rooms and suites open directly onto the gardens rather than onto long corridors.
facts.excerpt: Rather than the usual, long corridors lined with room numbers, most of our rooms and suites open directly onto gardens.

facts.text: The Canyon Studio has retractable walls opening onto a large private patio with a fireplace and spa pool.
facts.excerpt: retractable walls opening up to a large private patio with comfortable seating areas, fireplace and spa pool

facts.text: The Swan Lake Suite sits directly above Swan Lake.
facts.excerpt: the Swan Lake Suite sits exclusively above her namesake

facts.text: The Junior Pool Suite has a poolside setting and a private entrance.
facts.excerpt: Its exclusivity is accentuated by a private entrance, away from the eyes of the hotel.

facts.text: The pool area was once a horse-riding ring, transformed by owner Joseph Drown in the 1940s.
facts.excerpt: This former horse-riding ring was the vision of owner Joseph Drown, who transformed the property in the 1940s by personally directing his team of builders and gardeners.

facts.text: Robert Wagner started his career as one of the hotel's pool boys.
facts.excerpt: Robert Wagner started out his career as one of our pool boys

facts.text: One of Marilyn Monroe's most famous photo shoots for Vogue took place at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Marilyn Monroe loved this place, so it’s very fitting that one of her most famous photo shoots for Vogue took place here.

facts.text: The opening sequence of the 1965 film The Silencers shows Dean Martin beside the hotel pool.
facts.excerpt: The opening sequence of the 1965 movie The Silencers sees Dean Martin getting a soaking from his co-star Stella Stevens whilst relaxing beside our pool.

facts.text: The oval pool is heated for year-round use.
facts.excerpt: The pool is heated to 27.8˚C/82˚F for your comfort and year-round enjoyment.

facts.text: The pool is reserved for hotel guests only.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel Bel-Air pool is reserved for hotel guests only.

facts.text: The pool is family-friendly, and children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
facts.excerpt: It's family-friendly with no specific time slots. Please note that all children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

facts.text: The Restaurant serves modern Californian cuisine with a Mediterranean influence.
facts.excerpt: Delivering modern Californian cuisine with a Mediterranean influence in a relaxed, yet elegant setting.

facts.text: The Restaurant still serves the tortilla soup that debuted there in 1980.
facts.excerpt: We still serve the famous tortilla soup that debuted here in 1980.

facts.text: The Restaurant's alcoves overlook Swan Lake.
facts.excerpt: The alcoves peer over Swan Lake and glow like secret dens of vibrant conversation.

facts.text: A private dining room off the main dining room seats up to 18 people.
facts.excerpt: you’ll find an intimate private room seating up to 18 people

facts.text: Norman Seeff's photographs of figures such as Cher, Tina Turner and Steve Jobs line the walls of the Bar & Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Norman Seeff’s iconic photographs line the walls of the Bar & Lounge, capturing artists and innovators such Cher, Tina Turner and Steve Jobs in unique and unguarded moments.

facts.text: The Bar & Lounge has live music every evening.
facts.excerpt: The Bar & Lounge invites you to linger over a delicious cocktail while you enjoy our live music sessions every evening.

facts.text: The Bar & Lounge has a fireplace and a grand piano.
facts.excerpt: That incredible fireplace, the sleek grand piano, and an air of exclusive delight.

facts.text: The Patisserie's interiors are by Champalimaud Design, with classically French mosaic tiles.
facts.excerpt: Classically French mosaic tiles set the scene from the get-go. Champalimaud Design has drawn from its elegant take on interiors to create a beautiful backdrop

facts.text: The Patisserie has a gelato trolley with house-made gelato to enjoy in the courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Anyone for a cooling scoop of melt-in-the-mouth house-made gelato? A selection of fabulous flavours awaits you, created to be enjoyed in our calming courtyard

facts.text: Afternoon tea in The Living Room includes swan-inspired pastries, chilled champagne and finger sandwiches.
facts.excerpt: Swan-inspired pastries, glasses of chilled champagne, and a selection of deliciously refined finger sandwiches.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in The Living Room from Friday to Sunday.
facts.excerpt: afternoon tea is served in The Living Room on Friday, Saturday and Sundays from 3 to 6pm

facts.text: The Bel-Air Picnic is a gourmet chef-created menu of artisanal cheeses, sandwiches and seasonal pastries, enjoyed by Swan Lake or local beauty spots.
facts.excerpt: Our chefs have created a gourmet menu including artisanal cheeses, sandwiches and seasonal pastries.

facts.text: The spa uses Valmont facials with Swiss ingredients.
facts.excerpt: our innovative Valmont facials combine the best Swiss ingredients, proven to help restore and repair skin

facts.text: The spa has seven treatment rooms, a private enclave, a nail suite and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: It has seven treatment rooms, one private enclave, a nail suite and steam rooms.

facts.text: Hotel guests have 24-hour access to the fitness studio.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy 24-hour access to our fitness studio complete with cardiovascular equipment, weight machines, free weights and yoga mats.

facts.text: Up to two small dogs per room are welcome for a fee, with a bowl, bed and treats provided.
facts.excerpt: We welcome up to two small dogs per room (under 7kg/15lbs) at $150 per stay to cover deep cleaning. We provide a bowl, bed and treats for our furry friends.

facts.text: Breakfast is not automatically included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is not automatically included in your room rate.

facts.text: Parking is charged per day.
facts.excerpt: Parking is $70.00 per day.

facts.text: Swan Lake, with its grotto, arches, bridges and gazebos, hosts wedding ceremonies and receptions.
facts.excerpt: Paradise, from its delightful grotto to the fairytale arches, bridges and gazebos, all embraced in the wonders of nature. The serenity of Swan Lake is ideal for wedding ceremonies and receptions

facts.text: The Garden Ballroom has handmade mercury glass starburst chandeliers and an arched ceiling.
facts.excerpt: With its neutral interiors, handmade mercury glass starburst chandeliers and dramatic arched ceiling

facts.text: The hotel sits in an exclusive gated community removed from the bustle of Los Angeles.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located in an exclusive gated community deliberately removed from the hustle of LA.

facts.text: The hotel is designed in a Spanish Colonial style.
facts.excerpt: Spread across 12 acres and designed in a Spanish Colonial style

facts.text: Room interiors are by Alexandra Champalimaud.
facts.excerpt: all blend vintage Hollywood elegance with contemporary comfort, with interiors by Alexandra Champalimaud

facts.text: Bert Stern's 1962 photographs of Marilyn Monroe were taken at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The property even served as the setting for Bert Stern’s famed 1962 photographs of Marilyn Monroe

facts.text: Swans are resident on the property.
facts.excerpt: home to its resident swans Hercules, Athena, Odette, and Chloe

facts.text: The hotel is fully ADA compliant, with roll-in showers in accessible bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is fully ADA compliant

facts.text: The hotel last underwent a major renovation in 2011.
facts.excerpt: last underwent a major renovation in 2011

facts.text: The Restaurant calls itself LA's most extraordinary Hollywood restaurant.
facts.excerpt: LA's most extraordinary Hollywood restaurant

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the hotel the very definition of exclusivity.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel Bel-Air is the very definition of exclusivity.

facts.text: The Bar & Lounge is open daily from 2pm.
facts.excerpt: The Bar & Lounge is open daily at 2pm for drinks.

facts.text: The Bar & Lounge opens at 3pm.
facts.excerpt: Sunday – Thursday | 3 – 11pm
